ramps.name: 草地
ramps.note: Large flat areas use the base colour plus 2–3 sparse small tufts per tile. Scatter tiny flowers (#f3e6a2 / #f2b8c6 / #e9eef5) at about 3% of tiles. No noise texture.

ramps.name: 土路与广场
ramps.note: Path edges are soft and slightly wavy; a few grass tufts break into them. The plaza is the same earth, one step darker, ringed by a curb in stone grey (#a39c8c / #8e8a7e).

ramps.name: 溪流
ramps.note: Water is deeper in the middle and shallower at the edges. Ripples are short horizontal light streaks, 2–4 px long; animate them with 3 swapped frames. Banks: sand #d8c79a, pebbles #8e8a7e. No outline on water.

ramps.name: 水渠与石材
ramps.note: The canal has a stone edge and the same water as the creek, one step deeper. Stone bridges, shrine stairs, stone lanterns and house foundations all share this ramp.

ramps.name: 阔叶树
ramps.note: Build the canopy from 3–4 large rounded clumps, light on the upper left. Trunks: #7a5a42 / #5b4232. Keep tree shadows soft ellipses (#3b4a3a at 25%).

ramps.name: 针叶 · 竹
ramps.note: Cedars are tall and narrow and mark the shrine. Bamboo is drawn as vertical culms with leaf clusters; the grove casts dappled shade.

ramps.name: 季节点缀
ramps.note: Saturated colour belongs only here. Each screen gets one accent tree at most; persimmons cluster in the south lanes and cherry trees on Sakura Slope.

ramps.name: 建筑通用
ramps.note: Every building uses white plaster walls with dark wooden frames, horizontal planks on the lower half and a stone foundation. The engawa verandah is light wood.

ramps.name: 瓦与草顶
ramps.note: Homes have grey-blue kawara tiles with ridge tiles one step darker. Shop roofs use their own colour (see table). The shrine and the watermill have cypress-bark/thatch roofs. Eaves cast a shadow 6–8 native px deep.

ramps.name: 光照
ramps.note: Day is neutral-warm. Dusk tints everything orange. At night the ambient is dark blue and only lanterns, windows and the bonfire give warm light. Light pools are stepped rings, never smooth gradients.

buildings: Green noren printed with a sprout. Seed packet shelves and pots under the eaves. Wooden signboard.
Brass cowbell sign, a stack of hay bales, wide barn-style double doors. The display pen sits to its east.
Red noren. Shop front with a wooden display rack (snack jars), a bench and a small wind chime.
The largest building, with a deep gabled entrance. Long noticeboard by the door; indigo curtains.
Tall wooden lattice tower with a small roof and a hanging bell. The village's tallest silhouette.
Vermilion torii, a pair of fox statues, stone lanterns, a shimenawa rope and white paper streamers.
Engawa verandah, laundry pole, potted plants, a small vegetable patch. Give each house one personal touch: a persimmon tree, a bicycle, a cat.
Indigo noren printed with ♨. Chimney and rising steam, a bamboo fence around the outdoor footbath.
Large wooden waterwheel turning in the canal (4-frame animation). Grain sacks.
Small wooden bus shelter, bench, round sign on a pole, timetable board.
prompt:
Pixel art game asset, single object on a transparent background, Japanese countryside (satoyama) village in early summer, top-down 3/4 view (camera from the south, about 35° down), light from the upper left.
Style: clean hand-placed pixel art like Maggie's Garden; soft, warm, slightly low-saturation colours; 3–5 shades per material with hue shifting (cool shadows, warm highlights); selective dark-brown outline (#3a2a22), never pure black; no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur, no text.
Scale: native 16 px grid (do not upscale); the player character is 37 px tall, doors 28–30 px tall.
Object: [NAME], [SIZE IN NATIVE PX], [DETAILS FROM THE TABLE].
Palette: roof [ROOF HEX], walls #ede4d0, wood frame #6b4a33, stone base #a59e90, accent [ACCENT HEX].
Rules: door faces the camera (south). Shadow is a separate flat shape (#3b4a3a, 35%) falling to the lower right. Leave a 2 px transparent margin.
